text: The purpose of this report is to seek further instruction in relation to a development application for a site that contains several heritage resources, and a related ongoing appeal at the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal ("LPAT"). This report was prepared in consultation with Heritage Preservation Services.

The Toronto Preservation Board recommends that: 1. City Council adopt the confidential recommendations contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 12, 2019) from the City Solicitor. 2. City Council authorize the public release of the confidential recommendations contained in the Confidential Attachment 1, and Confidential Appendices A through D attached to the report (March 12, 2019) from the City Solicitor, if adopted by City Council. 3. City Council direct that all other information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 12, 2019) from the City Solicitor is to remain confidential at the discretion of the City Solicitor, as it contains advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege. 4. Pursuant to 415-19(D) of the Municipal Code, City Council assume approval authority for any site plan application for 280-290 Jarvis Street and 189 - 193 Mutual…
